questions.prompt: How should we restructure the main assessment layout for better data storytelling?
questions.description: Right now, it's a stacked group in one main panel. We can use Rich's Layout to divide the screen into distinct architectural regions.
questions.recommendedAnswer: A multi-pane dashboard using Rich Layout.

options.label: Multi-pane dashboard (header stats, left: active claim, right: log stream)
Keep stacked but improve spacing and optical alignment

questions.prompt: How should we visualize progress and accuracy?
questions.description: Currently we use simple ascii blocks. Rich has native Progress bars and Tables.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Use Rich's native Progress component for smoother, more precise visual tracking.

questions.prompt: How should the verified evidence log stream be presented?
questions.description: Currently it's a scrolling text group. We could use Trees, Tables, or Live displays.
questions.recommendedAnswer: A rich Table with clear status icons and staggered entrance animations.

options.label: Rich Table (structured columns for status, confidence, claim)

questions.prompt: What visual aesthetic should guide the styling (colors, borders)?
questions.description: Currently using heavy borders and a mix of bright colors (magenta/cyan).
questions.recommendedAnswer: Subtle concentric padding, rounded borders, and a restrained semantic color palette.

options.label: Restrained/Modern (rounded borders, semantic colors, deep spacing)
Retro Terminal (blocky, high contrast, heavy borders)
